headline_fact: China and the Philippines clashed three times in a single week in July 2026 at Scarborough Shoal and Second Thomas Shoal, prompting joint US-Philippines-Japan maritime drills; diplomatically, the two sides met in Cebu in January 2026 after nearly a year of frozen dialogue, reporting progress on a coast guard memorandum of understanding across three rounds of talks since.
